producer_report.summary: Records OLY-B-NOTE-01's mechanism in docs/spec.toml as the existing `specialization` status figure (planning.rs, shown by display.rs, measure ending `status: specialization`). Adds the snapshot print line in display.rs and a `specialization` field in SnapshotView (snapshot.rs). Adds tests in routing_evidence.rs for `display::status` (flag with enough jobs, no flag with fewer) and `display::snapshot_status`. Adds a CHANGELOG entry and a shard-timings line. On this send-back I ran the status command on the real records snapshot; the exact-sum check and the landing-time range check could not be confirmed (see criteria_check).

Flagged classes: code (sonnet high, 193 jobs), prompts (haiku unrecorded, 3 jobs), tests (sonnet unrecorded, 7 jobs); all at least 3.

Tracked changes are CHANGELOG.md, display.rs, snapshot.rs, spec.toml and shard-timings.txt; routing_evidence.rs is new and untracked. Nothing in the throughput, landing, keep-rule or planning-cost code changed.

criteria_check.criterion: In docs/spec.toml, requirement OLY-B-NOTE-01 has a mechanism that is no longer "none" and names crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs (`specialization`) and crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs, both found by Grep; owner stays Athena; measure says how it is shown and ends with `status: specialization`, a heading display.rs prints.
criteria_check.evidence: Spec edit is in the diff (docs/spec.toml, 4 lines changed); the status output above prints the `specialization` heading.

open_issues: Criterion 4: per-setting counts sum to 768 on the real records, but I did not obtain an independent count from history.json and the invocation records, so the 0-difference check is unconfirmed.

Criterion 5: I did not run a before/after comparison, because that needs git stash and I may not change git state. The diff does not touch the landing time, throughput, keep rule or planning cost code. The current landing time is a median of 2115.4 min (landing and rebuild 2098.8 min), which is not a few minutes; this is existing behavior, but I could not confirm the expected range.
mistakes: I cannot reproduce the independent count of dispatched request jobs with a producer invocation, so the exact-sum check is unconfirmed.
learnings: The producer shell hook denies redirects, `;`, `$?` and tail, so only single plain commands run.
desires: Allow shell redirection or a counting tool so independent counts from history.json and the invocation records can be computed.
